bpm.description: Only if sound.music has no bpm; the music bpm wins and must match.

name.description: Product or brand name shown on the end card.

contact.description: Contact line on the end card, e.g. a URL or phone number.

glow.description: Soft key light on the background.

accent.description: Accent words and highlights when the captured app has no theme.

mark.description: Font of the app icon monogram.

image.description: Path (relative to ad.yaml) of a real app icon. It is drawn instead of the monogram, cropped to the rounded icon shape.

dir.description: App folder. Supports ${ENV:-default}. Omit for a plain URL.

url.description: Base URL of an already running site (skips start/build).

isolate.description: Work in a copy under .adkit/ so the app folder is never touched.

start.description: Server command; {port} is replaced by a free port.

safeArea.description: Phone safe-area insets in px (env(safe-area-inset-*)), e.g. {top: 47, bottom: 34} for a notch phone, so apps leave room for the home indicator like on a real device.

routes.description: Answer matching requests with a fixed file, so live data (times, counts) is the same on every capture.

file.description: Response body file, relative to the spec. Put it in a folder listed in `inputs` so the capture cache sees changes.

clock.description: ISO time to freeze the browser clock at, so dates in screenshots are stable.

inputs.description: Files or folders (relative to the spec) that change what the app shows; hashed into the capture cache key.

extends.description: Inherit app settings from another set.

setup.description: Shell commands run (in the app folder) before building this set.

theme.description: Colours of this variant; used for backgrounds and highlights.

name.description: Omit to run steps without taking a shot.

goto.description: Path or URL. {var} is replaced by values saved with evaluate+save.

wait.description: Milliseconds, or wait for a selector.

evaluate.description: JavaScript run in the page (inline, or {file}).

save.description: Store the returned value as {name} for later steps.

elements.description: Named elements whose boxes the video can point at.

fixed.description: Sticky/fixed element: its box is stored in viewport coordinates, not page coordinates.

scroll.description: Scroll before the shot: a number of px, or bring an element to {offset} px below the top.

drawer.description: An overlay (sheet/drawer): shoot the viewport only, no full-page image.

id.description: Name used in cue names and error messages (default: block name + index).

bars.description: Length in bars; a whole number of beats (4/4: multiples of 0.25; 3/4: multiples of 1/3; 6/8: multiples of 1/6). The compiler checks it against the meter.

lines.description: Lines of text. *word* is the italic accent, _ is a non-breaking space.

at.description: Beat (relative to the block) when it enters.

to.description: Beat when it leaves; default: never (until the block ends).

y.description: Top of the text in px (default 270, inside the safe zone).

scrim.description: Soft gradient behind the text; true uses the paper colour.

instant.description: Fully on screen at its first frame (no word-by-word entrance). Use it for a title at frame 0 of the ad.

icon.description: Emoji or up to 3 characters drawn on the item (cards, tabs, toasts). Bubbles have no icon.

side.description: in = from the world to you (left); out = your own reply (right, tinted).

beat.description: Grid time: also emits a "ping" cue.

frame.description: Free time in frames from block start (may be negative = already on screen).

items.description: What piles up: messages, results, tabs or notifications. They arrive faster and faster.

look.description: bubbles = chat messages; cards = stacked app / search result cards; tabs = browser or app tabs piling up; toasts = notification banners.

size.description: Scales the item text. 1 = 42 px at 1080 wide, the smallest that reads on a phone. Fewer, bigger items read better than a long pile.

pings.description: More ping sounds (beats) that have no item.

counter.description: The red count that climbs while items pile up, or false for none.

label.description: Small text under the counter (e.g. "open tabs").

into.description: icon = items fly into an icon and an iconOpen block must follow; center = items collapse to one point and a flash cuts to the next block.

flyBeats.description: Beats before the end of the block when the items fly in.

title.description: Drawn inside the shaking scene; default colours are white and green.

pileTop.description: Top of the pile in px. Titles sit above it: keep titles (y + their height) above this line so nothing overlaps. Default 600 with into: icon, 250 with into: center.

tile.description: The tile the items fly into (before it becomes the app icon; into: icon only).

glyph.description: Drawn on the tile the items fly into: "chat" = a chat bubble (default), an emoji / up to 3 characters, or false = none.

color.description: Tile colour. Default: a green gradient for the chat glyph, the brand accent otherwise.

offset.description: Extra frames added to `at` (camera moves need not sit on the grid).

zoom.description: Zoom, or fit an element to a fraction of the frame width.

element.description: Look at this element (of the screen currently shown).

y.description: Phone screen y in px (default 422 = centre).

qy.description: Where on the frame (px from top) the focus point sits.

roll.description: Camera roll in degrees; omit to keep the current roll.

transition.description: How this screen replaces the previous block's screen. Default fade: a cross-fade, never a hard cut.

slide = pushes in from the right; cut = hard cut (a tab switch); fade = cross-fade; zoom = grows in from slightly smaller; sheet = the bottom of the new screen rises over the old one (capture the page with the sheet open, pinned to the bottom).

sheetHeight.description: transition sheet: height of the sheet in screen px.

scroll.description: Scroll in px, or bring an element to screen-y.

sticky.description: Pin the top N px (header) while scrolled.

elements.description: Elements (e.g. map pins) that appear one after another. The screen capture shows them in their final place.

stagger.description: Beats between one element and the next.

style.description: pin = drops in with a bounce; ring = pops in with an expanding ring; scale = grows from its centre.

under.description: A capture of the same page WITHOUT these elements. Needed on textured backgrounds (a map); on flat backgrounds the page colour is used.

element.description: The input box (it should look empty in the capture).

beats.description: How long the typing takes. A tick sound comes every half beat.

scroll.description: Also scroll the page by this many px while the finger moves (the finger stays on the same content point; `to` then only sets where it ends sideways).

x.description: Where along the element width the finger lands.

press.description: Pop the element out and press it.

tap.description: Element of the lifted card the finger presses.

to.description: Element the lifted card flies into (e.g. the cart icon).

note.description: A small line under the contact line (e.g. "free, no sign-up"). Kept out of the bottom 400 px.

phone.description: Where the phone rests during the end card.

y.description: Phone centre offset from the frame centre, px. Default 535 puts the phone in the bottom half and crops it; about 0.8 with y 370 shows the whole phone above the bottom 400 px.

music.description: The music as data (or {file: music.json}). Required: there is no default song.

bpm.description: Beats per minute. x/4: quarter notes; 6/8, 9/8, 12/8: dotted quarters (override with meter.bpm_counts).

instruments.description: name -> {model, preset, params, octave, gain, pan, fx ...}

sounds.description: name -> SOUND. Every sound has a `meaning`.

meaning.description: What object in the product's world this sound is, and why it is in the ad (at least 4 words).

layers.description: [{model, preset, params, note, at, gain, pan, fx, reverse, repeat}]

tune.description: "chord": the written notes are in the key of the music and move to the chord that plays at the cue time.

cues.description: Cue name (block:cue), role (tap, paid, ...) or kind (tap, pop, whoosh, ...) -> sound. Name wins over role, role over kind. "silent" is an explicit silence.

anyOf.description: The name of a sound in `sounds`, or "silent".

sound.description: Name of a sound in `sounds`, or "silent".

pan.description: -1 left .. 1 right. Taps with a pan in the spec use it when this is not set.

duck.description: dB the music dips under this cue for 150 ms (default: mix.duckMusic).

variations.description: How many seeds the sound rotates through, so repeats do not sound identical.

align.description: "end": a cue with a duration (riser, count) ends the sound when the cue ends.

reason.description: Why this cue shares a sound with another role (silences the warning).

duckMusic.description: Default dB the music dips under every cue (150 ms). A cue can set its own `duck`.

musicGain.description: dB added to the music before the cues are mixed in.

seed.description: Base seed for the sounds (the music has its own seed).

wordsPerSecond.description: Reading speed for the reading-time check: a median adult reads about 238 words a minute, about 4 a second.

noticeSeconds.description: Time to notice a title before reading it. Added to words / wordsPerSecond.

appTextSeconds.description: App text the story depends on (a camera push-in target) should stay still on screen this long.

maxJump.description: continuity check: the largest allowed sudden rise, in mean pixel change (0-255), from one frame pair to the next. A hard cut or a snap rises by 15-250 in one frame; a smooth move or fade builds up slowly.

cuts.description: continuity check: frames where a hard cut is intended (the frame that shows the new picture). They are not reported.
